name: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya
description: About Us The 1st Dec, 1988 was the most auspicious day when the foundation stone of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Longding,Tirap was laid down. The school campus covers around 32 Acres of forested hillside with its buildings connected by steep and windy paths and offering spectacular views at every turn. These buildings include the beautiful old Quad, the modern state of art infrastructure and the newly-refurbished student hostels and staff houses. The academic buildings including several classrooms are linked by a computer network. The widespread use of email and an intranet system shrinks the distances and keeps staff, students and administration in quick and easy contact with one another. The Vidyalaya is surrounded by the beautiful trees on the main Khapcho at Longding.

name: Donyi Polo Vidya Bhawan
description: About Us Founded on 14th November 1981 under the noble umbrella of the Donyi Polo Mission, Donyi Polo Vidya Bhawan is more than just a school, it is a vision turned into reality. The dream belonged to Shri Gegong Apang, the 3rd Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh, who firmly believed that every Arunachalee child deserves access to world-class education within the state itself. With just three students and one teacher, this humble journey began in a serene corner of Itanagar, guided by his principle that an institute must be far from noise, close to nature, and secular in character. Today, after 43 glorious years, the school stands tall on a vast 50-acre lush green campus, proudly affiliated to CBSE, New Delhi (Affiliation No. 223007), and recognized by the Government of Arunachal Pradesh (EED/A/28/2022-23). Catering from Class I to XII, it is the only school in Arunachal Pradesh that holds membership in the prestigious Indian Public Schools’ Conference (IPSC). Here, education goes beyond classrooms. The school blends academic excellence with discipline, leadership, culture, and values, nurturing not just students, but future-ready citizens and leaders. Generations of young minds have walked through its gates, carrying with them the strength of knowledge, confidence, and character.

name: Sainik School
description: About Us Sainik School East Siang (SSES), Arunachal Pradesh has been raised on 27 August 2018 as a 28 th Sainik School of India. SSES is a residential school for Boys & Girls (Cadets) towards providing Public School Education along with Military orientation an intake at Class VI and Class IX. The aim of Sainik School East Siang is to prepare young boys and girls to join Defence Services, namely National Defence Academy (NDA), Indian Naval Academy (INA) and all other military academies. The School is spread over 100 acres near the banks of Sille River, located at Niglok village. By road 6 kms away from Ruksin, near Arunachal-Assam Boarder. Murkongselek is the nearest railway station, situated approximately 10 kms from the school, and private taxi services are available for commuting. Nearest Airport is Pasighat at a distance of 35 kms from the school.
